name: comparing glance, hypocritical point-off
rationale: Treats the meme as a comparison and a standoff. The gaze flicks back and forth between two spots, ears up in suspicion, as if checking one double against the other. Then come two quick jabbing forward points as separate accusing beats, aimed at different targets. Last, a playful head sway with one ear cocked suggests amused recognition and a shared laugh instead of real anger.
